title: Car Mirror Khud Dim Hota Hai, Magic Nahi Hai 🌙 #shorts
description:
Raat mein car ka mirror khud dim kyun hota hai? Jawab chhupa hai ek light sensor mein, jise aap Arduino se bana sakte ho.
🌙 Auto-dimming mirror ka asli kaam 3D mein
🔬 LDR ke andar CdS track aur electrons ka khel
⚡ LM393 comparator aur pot se threshold
🔌 Arduino wiring ki ek save-worthy tip
Aur aise 3D explainers ke liye subscribe karo!
